title: Hostinger Review 2026: Pricing, Speed Test, AI Tools and Renewal Costs
excerpt: Hostinger starts at $1.99 a month and lists more AI tools than most cheap hosts. Here is what you pay after the sale, how fast it was in an independent test, and who should look elsewhere.

meta._yoast_wpseo_title: Hostinger Review 2026: Pricing, Speed Test, AI Tools
meta._yoast_wpseo_metadesc: Hostinger review for 2026: plan and renewal prices, a nine-day speed and uptime test from All About Cookies, AI tools, the Black Friday offer, pros and cons.
meta.rl_answer: Hostinger is a fast, low-cost host for beginners and small sites. Two independent tests measured 100% uptime. The sale price needs a 48-month term, and renewals cost about 5.5 times more.
meta.rl_faqs:
Is Hostinger good? | Yes for beginners, blogs and small business sites. Two independent tests measured 100% uptime, and All About Cookies recorded a 138 ms average response. The trade-offs are higher renewal prices and basic security.
Is Hostinger legit? | Yes. It is an established host with data centers on four continents, a 30-day money-back guarantee and a Trustpilot score in the 4.4 to 4.7 range, according to Cybernews.
How much does Hostinger cost? | Premium is $1.99 a month on a 48-month term and renews at $10.99 a month, according to Hostinger's own pages. Over five years it averages about $3.79 a month.
Why is Hostinger so cheap? | The lowest price needs a long term, so you pay for four years at checkout. After that the renewal price is about 5.5 times higher on Premium.
Is Hostinger good for WordPress? | Yes. Crazy Egg describes LiteSpeed servers and about 500 ms load times, and All About Cookies scored a paid plan 99 out of 100 on page speed.
Is Hostinger good for an online store? | It can run WooCommerce on the higher plans, but All About Cookies notes that Hostinger is not PCI compliant. If you take card payments on the site, use a payment provider that handles the card step.
Does Hostinger have phone support? | No. Support is 24/7 live chat and email. Chat starts with an AI assistant and moves to a person when needed.
Does Hostinger have a money-back guarantee? | Yes. Hostinger lists a 30-day money-back guarantee.
What AI features does Hostinger have? | An AI website builder, AI credits, an AI assistant called Hostinger Agent, an MCP server for its API and automatic llms.txt files on custom domains.
Is Hostinger better than GoDaddy? | On price and speed, yes. All About Cookies measured 138 ms against 288 ms for GoDaddy. GoDaddy has stronger support and a clear path to PCI compliance.

meta.rl_takeaways:
Premium is $1.99 a month on a 48-month term and renews at $10.99.
Two independent tests measured 100% uptime: 138 ms average response (All About Cookies) and 29 ms (Cybernews).
Over five years, Premium averages about $3.79 a month.
Hostinger is not PCI compliant, and there is no phone support.
meta.rl_r_verdict: Hostinger is one of the strongest low-price starting points for a new site. Two independent tests measured 100% uptime, and the sale price is hard to beat. Budget for the renewal, and look elsewhere if you take card payments or need phone support.
meta.rl_r_buy:
You are launching a blog, a portfolio or a small business site.
You want speed and AI tools included in a low price.
You can commit for four years, or you will use the 30-day refund to try it first.
meta.rl_r_skip:
You take card payments directly on your site, because Hostinger is not PCI compliant.
You need phone support or a person on every call.
You want the lowest price on a short term, or a dedicated server.
meta.rl_r_pros:
Very low sale prices from $1.99 a month.
100% uptime in two independent tests.
Fast: 138 ms and 29 ms average response in the two tests.
AI website builder, AI assistant and MCP server included.
30-day money-back guarantee.
Free domain for the first year and free migration for WordPress sites.
meta.rl_r_cons:
The sale price needs a 48-month term.
Renewal is about 5.5 times the sale price on Premium.
Not PCI compliant, and security is basic.
No phone support, and chat starts with an AI assistant.
No dedicated servers.
